author: Unknown; Jewish tradition names Jeremiah
date: Events c. 850–560 BC; completed during the exile
overview: The prophet Elisha continues Elijah's work. Most kings turn away from God, and the northern kingdom falls to Assyria in 722 BC. Despite reforms under Hezekiah and Josiah, Jerusalem is destroyed by Babylon in 586 BC and the people are taken into exile.
storyPlace: The decline and fall of both kingdoms, ending in exile.
